101-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7084-7272-8337.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-8337.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.

1765-2440-6968-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

1409-2499-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve both Kalain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

225-1671-5449-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1636-6773-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-6773-6797.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

618-5686-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1-2428-5014-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2428-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

38-2420-2646.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-2646.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

486-509-1267-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
486-509-1267-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian
729-2440-4183-4758.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Great Oak Guardian for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1069-1115-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.

Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

552-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six basic Swamps.
552-2608-4499.description:
Activate Cabal Stronghold by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cabal Stronghold.
Repeat.

780-1303-2974-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Repository Skaab.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Repository Skaab, adding {B}.
When Repository Skaab dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its exploit ability and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of it.
When the Repository Skaab token enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger from step 4, sacrificing the Repository Skaab token.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Supernatural Stamina to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

11-1170-2196-4074.notablePrerequisites:
You control three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
11-1170-2196-4074.description:
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Frantic Search.
 Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Frantic Search and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning it to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.

2836-4400.description:
